rdf:Description.skos:prefLabel: Refactor RML Execution Logic from map_rml.py
rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the RML execution logic from `map_rml.py`. The logic will be moved into a new `RMLMapper` class in `gbad_core/mapper.py`, which will be independent of the specific RML mapper implementation.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote:
**Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python def map_using_rmlmapper(rml, ttl): """Run the RMLMapper Java command.""" # ... java_command = [ "java", "-jar", rmlmapper, "-s", "turtle", "-m", rml, "-o", ttl, "-b", BASE_URI[:-1] ] # ...
def map_using_pyrml(rml, ttl): """Create an instance of RML Mapper with PyRML.""" raise NotImplementedError() ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `RMLMapper` Class:** - Create a new class `RMLMapper` in `gbad_core/mapper.py`. 2. **Implement `map()` Method:** - The `RMLMapper` class will have a `map()` method that takes an RML mapping and a source CSV as input. 3. **Abstract Away Implementation:** - The `map()` method will be designed to be independent of the specific RML mapper implementation. It will use a configurable "mapper strategy" (e.g., "rmlmapper-jar", "pyrml") to execute the mapping. 4. **Implement JAR Strategy:** - The initial implementation will support the existing RMLMapper JAR file. The logic for calling the JAR file will be moved into a private method of the `RMLMapper` class.
